_meta.title: Average federal tax rate by income group, published anchor years 1979-2022
_meta.source: CBO, The Distribution of Household Income, 2022 (January 2026), Supplemental Data Table 9, Average Federal Tax Rates by Income Group, 1979 to 2022

units.v.*: percent of income before means-tested transfers and federal taxes

notes: INCLUDES PAYROLL TAX, corporate income tax and excise tax, not individual income tax alone. This is why it cannot be compared to the income-tax-only shares in income_tax_by_group.
These are PUBLISHED ANCHOR YEARS, not an annual series. Never draw a connecting line between them; the years in between were not observed by this table.
The lowest quintile's average rate fell to near zero (0.6% in 2019, 1.4% in 2022) as refundable credits grew; it was 9.3% in 1979.

refresh.reason: source publishes as a document, not a machine-readable feed

data.basis: Average federal tax rate: individual income tax, payroll (social insurance) tax, corporate income tax and excise tax combined, as a share of income before means-tested transfers and federal taxes. INCLUDES PAYROLL TAX, so this is not comparable to the income-tax-only shares in income_tax_by_group.
data.not_an_annual_series: Published anchor years only, each transcribed from the report's own table for that year's Distribution of Household Income vintage. Never chart these as a continuous line; the years between them are not observed.
